subject: Nellie's Wildflowers Business Spotlight
overview: Anna Callahan interviewed Joyce McKenzie about the history of Nellie's Wildflowers and how the business adapted to the COVID-19 pandemic. The discussion highlighted the shop's 30th anniversary and provided details for holiday ordering and delivery.

items.title: Business Background and History
items.summary: Joyce McKenzie discussed opening the shop in 1990 and naming it after her grandmother.

items.title: COVID-19 Business Impact
items.summary: The shop remained operational during the pandemic by shifting to online ordering and providing free local delivery to the community.

items.title: Holiday Services and Contact Information
items.summary: McKenzie detailed the store's holiday hours, curbside pickup options, and wide delivery range for customers.
